title: Hearth of Stars
shortDescription: Night windows keep company with ink-stained charts.
longDescription:
The Hearth of Stars is a loft that pretends it is only a study. Brass instruments wait beside a star-wheel. Charts are pinned where a draught cannot steal them. The windows hold more night than the hour should allow, and the air smells of ink, cold glass, and a little lamp-oil.
Mentor Lumen has ink on her primaries and no patience for guesswork dressed as wonder.
A straw hearth dummy stands where a lesson can be finished without guessing.

fixtures.name: Mentor Lumen
fixtures.lookDescription: A barn owl with ink-stained primaries and a star-chart satchel. Try talk lumen.
fixtures.examineDescription: Lumen's facial disc is pale and severe. The satchel is heavy with charts, not stories. She corrects a wrong azimuth the way other teachers correct a sloppy stance.
fixtures.dialogue: Lumen has the star-wheel set and a column of figures half finished. "Stars is a bearing written down before you walk. Charts first. Wonder keeps." She taps the straw dummy in the corner with the end of her pen. "Talk lumen when you want to begin."

welcome.text: "Ink, cold glass, lamp-oil. Look around this hearth. Charts before wonder. Then attack the hearth dummy in here, mine and not the one Flint keeps out in his orchard, unless you are still learning the spark on his. Come back and talk to me. I will open this School's leaf and ink its stem."

craft.text: "The Field Primer is your book, not a wish flung at the night. I open this School's leaf and ink the stem after you look around this hearth, defeat the dummy, and talk to me. Later the Primer holds ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name. Write the hour before you name the star."

go.text: "Look around this hearth. Defeat the dummy. I will be here with the charts. Guesswork dressed as wonder will not pass."

lessons-done.text: "The stem is inked. Cast azimuth at the hearth dummy for the second lesson. After that, the Primer holds one ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name."

third-lesson.text: "Your chart is rolled and your name is on it. Talk to Headmaster Alder in the High Study, up from the Great Hall. If he has you on the Clock Tower stair, finish it first. When he says the grounds will teach the rest, come back and talk to me."

third-done.text: "This hearth has taught you what it holds. Each lesson off the grounds leaves one ink in the Primer, and I sign the page whether I am at your shoulder or not." She notes the date in her own book. "Keeper Holm kept a stair lit so first-years would not walk it in the dark. Eat something warm before you walk a cold road."

fixtures.name: Star Wheel
fixtures.examineDescription: The brass ring is nicked from careful hands. Tonight's marks are already set. A slate says: 'Write the hour before you name the star.'
